knowledge.libraryDescription: A shared place to browse, review, and keep useful knowledge organized.
knowledge.workspaceDescription: Find an item by status, then review its context and confidence on the right.
knowledge.confidenceMeaning: shows how reliable and reusable this item appears to be. Higher values are more likely to be useful right away.
knowledge.activeNote: These items are ready to be found and reused.
knowledge.emptyActive: No active knowledge yet. Once your agents share useful activity, new knowledge will appear here.
knowledge.emptyDescription: New knowledge will appear here as your agents share useful activity.
knowledge.noMatches: No Knowledge items match this search.
knowledge.noMatchesDescription: Try another search term, or clear the search to see everything.
knowledge.detailReasonActive: This item is ready to be found and reused.
knowledge.detailReasonReview: This item is waiting for your confirmation before it can be used again.
knowledge.detailReasonArchived: This item is kept as history and is not used in current searches.
knowledge.selectItem: Choose an item to view its details.
knowledge.reviewThresholdNote: Items below {{threshold}} confidence are shown here for review.
knowledge.archivedNote: Kept as history. You can restore an item or delete it permanently.
knowledge.emptyAll: No knowledge yet. Once your agents share useful activity, it will appear here.
knowledge.emptyReview: Nothing needs review right now — your knowledge looks good.
knowledge.restoreSuccess: The item was restored to Active.
knowledge.usefulSuccess: Marked as useful. It will stay active.
knowledge.unmarkPrivateSuccess: The item is no longer private.
knowledge.reviewSuccess: The item was moved to Review.
